dc:title: Two synthetic examples; not Google or client observations

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Identifies a reported aggregate with derived values or an entirely synthetic illustration; never an observed Canadian client outcome.

columns.name: starting_reviews
columns.dc:description: Constructed starting cohort size; not sampled Google reviews.

columns.name: deleted_on_day
columns.dc:description: Assumed elapsed event day in the synthetic example.

columns.name: deleted_count
columns.dc:description: Assumed deletion count in the synthetic example.

columns.name: still_visible_at_day_30
columns.dc:description: Constructed observations censored at day 30; no later event time is assumed.

columns.name: follow_up_days
columns.dc:description: Synthetic observation period in elapsed days.

columns.name: deleted_only_median_days
columns.dc:description: Median among constructed deleted reviews only; excludes still-visible reviews.

columns.name: observed_deletion_fraction_percent
columns.dc:description: Synthetic event count divided by synthetic starting reviews × 100; not a measured Google removal rate.

columns.name: population_median_deletion_day
columns.dc:description: Synthetic full-cohort median event day, blank when not reached during follow-up.

columns.name: population_median_status
columns.dc:description: Whether the constructed full cohort reaches a 50% deletion fraction within follow-up.

columns.name: source_url
columns.dc:description: Attribution URL for reported values; blank for original constructed examples.

columns.name: notes
columns.dc:description: Interpretation limits and assumptions for this row.
